data.name: Lily's Dream World
data.detailed_description:
WHAT'S GOIN' ON?

Lily's taking a good old nap in her 6th grade biology class, until... BOOM! In the middle of her nap, she plummets straight into a fantasy dream world, where her closest friends have been twisted into super-evil pawns of the SUPER EVIL WIZARD™! Even worse, the SUPER EVIL WIZARD™ appears to have kidnapped her best friend and honorary princess of the dream world, Trey! Together with his pawns, the SUPER EVIL WIZARD™ takes Trey to the top of his super DUPER evil Tower of Doom and Despair, where each one of his pawns awaits in their respective floor for the hero to arrive....

However, not all hope is lost! Lily has been bequeathed the destiny of the hero(ine), tasked to save Princess(?) Trey from the wizard! Armed with the trusted Sword of Heroism, Lily steps into the Tower of Doom and Despair, braving herself for the challenges to come...

OK, BUT WHAT'S THE GAMEPLAY?

Delve into Lily's shoes and enter the challenge of the Tower of Doom and Despair, where you'll....

  • Explore a variety of lush environments with each floor

  • Strategically cycle between 2 different JRPG styles to gain the battle advantage

  • Discover hilarious and charming interactions between characters and enemies alike!

  • Engage in strange and borderline insane minigames! (torture?!!)

This game is being made by one guy?! What the heck is wrong with him!!

data.short_description: Plunge straight into a dream world full of charming classmates, wacky minigames, and formidable foes in this atypical, hand-crafted fantasy turn-based RPG! Negotiate or brute-force your way to the top of a menacing tower, where you'll face a climactic battle, where the stakes have never been higher!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100/AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000/NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: This is an estimate based on seeing how my old and new devices handled the game
